mockData.name: MIT
mockData.reason:
Overall strength: world-leading in science and engineering with intense rigor and research.
Fit: Excellent for students aiming at top-tier STEM, research, or tech entrepreneurship.
Location: Cambridge, MA, next to Boston—strong in education, biotech, and tech; cold winters and high cost of living.
Alumni: Extremely influential across technology and startups.
Website: https://www.mit.edu/

mockData.name: Stanford University
mockData.reason:
Overall strength: consistently top-ranked with outstanding balance across STEM, humanities, business, and medicine.
Fit: Strong for innovation, entrepreneurship, and interdisciplinary study; CS and EE closely tied to Silicon Valley.
Location: Heart of Silicon Valley—unmatched internship and startup access; high cost of living.
Alumni: Deep networks across tech and venture capital.
Website: https://www.stanford.edu/

mockData.name: Carnegie Mellon University
mockData.reason:
Overall strength: elite private research university, especially renowned for computer science, engineering, and the arts.
Fit: Ideal for students targeting CS, robotics, AI, or drama/design at a very high level.
Location: Pittsburgh, PA—affordable compared with the coasts; smaller tech hub than SF or Boston.
Alumni: Highly respected in software, AI, and robotics.
Website: https://www.cmu.edu/

mockData.name: UC Berkeley
mockData.reason:
Overall strength: top public research university with world-class programs in CS, engineering, and many other fields.
Fit: Strong match for rigorous technical majors and research-oriented students.
Location: Berkeley, CA, near San Francisco and Silicon Valley; competitive housing and cost of living.
Alumni: Large, powerful network across tech, academia, and public service.
Website: https://www.berkeley.edu/

mockData.name: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
mockData.reason:
Overall strength: leading public university with flagship engineering and CS programs.
Fit: Excellent value and outcomes for engineering, CS, and related fields.
Location: Champaign–Urbana, IL—college-town setting; farther from major coastal cities.
Alumni: Very strong pipeline into top technology companies.
Website: https://illinois.edu/

mockData.name: University of Washington
mockData.reason:
Overall strength: highly ranked public university with standout CS, medicine, and life sciences.
Fit: Close ties to Seattle’s tech industry (Amazon, Microsoft, etc.); some majors are capacity-constrained.
Location: Seattle, WA—major tech hub; rainy climate.
Alumni: Strong presence across Pacific Northwest technology firms.
Website: https://www.washington.edu

mockData.name: Purdue University
mockData.reason:
Overall strength: well-known for engineering, technology, and agriculture.
Fit: Strong practical training in aerospace, mechanical, industrial, and computer engineering.
Location: West Lafayette, IN—classic college town; lower cost of living than coastal cities.
Alumni: Highly regarded in manufacturing and aerospace industries.
Website: https://www.purdue.edu/

mockData.name: Ohio State University
mockData.reason:
Overall strength: one of the largest U.S. public universities with broad national strength across disciplines.
Fit: Strong business, engineering, and social sciences with many pathways and majors.
Location: Columbus, OH—growing Midwest city with moderate cost of living.
Alumni: Very large, active alumni base across the United States.
Website: https://www.osu.edu/
